text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out with Mejiro Ramonu, I 
spotted a crane game filled with plushies 
themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: It's a Paka Petit! A Paka Petit!
It's a Paka Petit! A Paka Petit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, an Umamusume doll, right? ...What 
about it?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A Paka Petit symbolizes passion for 
racing, commemoration, popularity, 
history... It is a true emblem.
choice_data_list:
A Paka Petit is the physical embodiment of 
love for racing.

A Paka Petit is the physical embodiment of 
love for racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Turning love into art... is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As someone involved in racing, it piqued 
my interest. But taking a detour right in 
front of Mejiro Ramonu—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
That look in your eyes... You want this, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Why don't you take it? There's no need 
to hold back.
choice_data_list:
Thank you! I'll definitely get my hands on 
it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
